Package neqsim.process.equipment.filter

Class FilterPerformanceCurve

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.filter.FilterPerformanceCurve
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class FilterPerformanceCurve extends Object implements Serializable
Particle-size dependent filtration performance represented by beta ratios.

The beta ratio is the upstream particle count divided by the downstream count for particles at or above a stated size. Fractional removal is therefore 1 - 1 / beta. Curves can hold supplier or laboratory multi-pass test results such as data produced using ISO 16889. NeqSim does not invent a standard performance class or certify an element; the caller supplies the applicable test points.

1.0

      public double getBetaRatio(double particleSizeMicrometre)
      Returns the beta ratio at a particle size using log-linear interpolation.

      Values outside the supplied size range use the nearest endpoint rather than extrapolation.

      Returns:
      interpolated beta ratio, or one when the curve is empty
